items.what: v2.4.0 (Nov 11, 2026) fixes two vulnerabilities in @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem 2.3.0. Package managers rank 2.3.0 below every 2025.x and 2026.x date version, so they won't offer it as an upgrade.
items.test: If you run a date version of server-filesystem, install it explicitly: npm install @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem@2.3.0, then confirm the version your MCP client launches.

items.what: mcp-server-git 2026.11.11 (in v2.4.0) stops a repository's own Git config from making the server run a program, and refuses a Git older than 2.31.
items.test: Run git --version on every machine or image that runs mcp-server-git; upgrade Git to 2.31 or newer before moving to 2026.11.11.

items.what: mcp-server-fetch 2026.11.11 (in v2.4.0) now refuses IPv6 site-local fec0::/10 and other IPv6 addresses outside 2000::/3 without an IPv4 address, and matches robots.txt against the resolved path.
items.test: After upgrading, re-run any fetch calls that hit internal IPv6 hosts or paths like //private; expect them to be refused now.
